seed_laws.title: Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria (1999, as amended)
seed_laws.description: The supreme law of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.
seed_laws.public_explanation: The foundational constitution of Nigeria, defining the structure of government, fundamental rights, and the relationship between federal and state governments.

provisions.title: Supremacy of the Constitution
provisions.description: The Constitution is supreme and its provisions shall have binding force on all authorities and persons throughout the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

provisions.title: Federal Republic of Nigeria
provisions.description: Nigeria is one indivisible and indissoluble sovereign state to be known by the name of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

provisions.title: Right to Life
provisions.description: Every person has a right to life, and no one shall be deprived intentionally of his life.

provisions.title: Right to Dignity
provisions.description: Every individual is entitled to respect for the dignity of his person.

provisions.title: Right to Personal Liberty
provisions.description: Every person is entitled to his personal liberty.

provisions.title: Right to Fair Hearing
provisions.description: In the determination of his civil rights and obligations, every person shall be entitled to a fair hearing within a reasonable time by a court or other tribunal established by law.

provisions.title: Right to Freedom of Expression
provisions.description: Every person shall be entitled to freedom of expression, including freedom to hold opinions and to receive and impart ideas and information without interference.

provisions.title: Right to Assembly
provisions.description: Every person shall be entitled to assemble freely and associate with other persons.

provisions.title: Right to Freedom of Movement
provisions.description: Every citizen of Nigeria is entitled to move freely throughout Nigeria and to reside in any part thereof.

provisions.title: Right to Freedom from Discrimination
provisions.description: A citizen of Nigeria of a particular community, ethnic group, place of origin, sex, religion or political opinion shall not be treated in a discriminatory manner.

provisions.title: Right to Acquire and Own Immovable Property
provisions.description: Subject to the provisions of this Constitution, every citizen of Nigeria shall have the right to acquire and own immovable property anywhere in Nigeria.

provisions.title: Compulsory Acquisition of Property
provisions.description: No moveable property or any interest in an immovable property shall be taken possession of compulsorily without prompt payment of compensation.

seed_laws.title: Criminal Code Act
seed_laws.description: The Criminal Code applicable in the Southern States of Nigeria.
seed_laws.public_explanation: Defines criminal offences and penalties applicable in southern Nigeria.

provisions.title: Application
provisions.description: This Code applies to the Southern States of Nigeria.

provisions.title: Motor vehicle dangerous driving
provisions.description: Any person who drives a motor vehicle on any road recklessly or negligently shall be guilty of an offence.

provisions.title: Punishment
provisions.description: A person guilty of an offence under section 23 shall be liable to imprisonment for six months or a fine.

seed_laws.title: Land Use Act
seed_laws.description: The Land Use Act vests all land in each state in the Governor.
seed_laws.public_explanation: Governs the ownership, use, and transfer of land in Nigeria. All land in each state is vested in the Governor in trust for the people.

provisions.title: Management and Control of Land
provisions.description: Subject to the provisions of this Decree, all land comprised in the territory of each State in the Federation are hereby vested in the Governor of that State.

provisions.title: Power to Issue Statutory Right of Occupancy
provisions.description: The Governor may grant a statutory right of occupancy to any person for all purposes and in respect of all areas of land within the urban area of the State.

seed_laws.title: Tenancy Law of Lagos State
seed_laws.description: Governs landlord-tenant relationships in Lagos State.
seed_laws.public_explanation: Regulates tenancy agreements, rent, eviction procedures, and landlord-tenant rights in Lagos State.

provisions.title: Application
provisions.description: This Law applies to premises situated in Lagos State.

provisions.title: Recovery of Premises
provisions.description: A landlord or his agent may apply to the appropriate court for an order to recover possession of any premises from a tenant.

seed_laws.title: Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020
seed_laws.description: Governs the registration, management, and regulation of companies in Nigeria.
seed_laws.public_explanation: Provides the legal framework for incorporating, managing, and winding up companies in Nigeria, and for related matters.

provisions.title: Application
provisions.description: This Act applies to all companies incorporated under this Act and to all foreign companies operating in Nigeria.

provisions.title: Contractual capacity of company
provisions.description: A company shall have the capacity to contract.
